'''Written Cheunh''' was the [[Writing/Legends|written form]] of [[Cheunh/Legends|Cheunh]] [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]]. The concepts were represented<ref name="Gamer 5" /> with symbolic ideograms,<ref name="FF137" /> and the agglutinative features of the spoken language were reflected in the written form, which combined simpler ideograms to present more complex ideas.<ref name="Gamer 5" />
